entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bazilije Stjepan Pandžić was a Bosnian-Croat historian, archivist and orientalist. He entered the Franciscan Order in 1935 and was ordained for a Catholic priest in 1941. From 1947 to 1985 he was the general archivist and analyst of the Franciscan Order in Rome. In 1958 he was elected vice-president of the International Association of Church Archives. He turned 100 in January 2018, and in April 2019, died at the age of 101.

entities.summary: Bazilije Stjepan Pandžić was a Bosnian-Croat historian, archivist and orientalist. He entered the Franciscan Order in 1935 and was ordained for a Catholic priest in 1941. From 1947 to 1985 he was the general archivist and analyst of the Franciscan Order in Rome. In 1958 he was elected vice-president of the International Association of Church Archives. He turned 100 in January 2018, and in April 2019, died at the age of 101.
